items.title: NHL-best Hurricanes close lengthy trip at energized Blues
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The league-leading Carolina Hurricanes are set to close the book on a reasonably successful five-game road swing when they face the surging St. Louis Blues on Saturday.
items.body:
The league-leading Carolina Hurricanes are set to close the book on a reasonably successful five-game road swing when they face the surging St. Louis Blues on Saturday.
Carolina took five of a possible eight points (2-1-1) during a four-game stretch against Canadian Western Conference opponents, capped off with a 6-5 shootout loss to the Edmonton Oilers on Thursday.
The Hurricanes were unable to contain the Oilers' top dogs as Connor McDavid and Leon Draisaitl racked up two goals and three assists apiece.
Juuso Valimaki handed the Hurricanes the lead with just 2:40 left in regulation. They looked poised to sneak away with the victory before McDavid sent it to the extra frame off a lucky bounce with 1:28 left.
It wasn't all bad news for the defending Stanley Cup champions, though, as Seth Jarvis scored a highlight-reel goal in his first game back from offseason shoulder surgery.
"The first period, I wasn't feeling too great. I was just kind of catching up to the game," Jarvis said. "After that, I thought I got my legs back and got a lot better."
The 24-year-old winger went on to criticize his defensive struggles in his first game back.
"One of my biggest things is defense and being responsible," he said. "I thought that part was kind of lacking (Thursday), and that's a big reason why we didn't pull this one out. Obviously, there's some stuff to clean up, but I mean, I kind of expected that coming into my first game."
Sebastian Aho finished with a goal and an assist while Jordan Martinook and Shayne Gostisbehere each tallied a pair of assists.
The Blues are singing a happier tune heading into the tough matchup after receiving help from an unlikely hero.
Defenseman Justin Barron recorded his first career four-point game (one goal, three assists) as the Blues took down the Vegas Golden Knights 6-2 on home ice Thursday.
The matchup with last season's Western Conference champions was Barron's best of the seven games he has played with St. Louis since he was claimed off waivers from the Nashville Predators on Sept. 27.
"I just wanted to come in (with) obviously a little bit of a clean slate," Barron said. "Obviously, there's been some injuries here and just try to come into the lineup and prove myself."
Dylan Holloway scored twice and notched an assist to extend his point streak to six games (three goals, seven assists), while Jimmy Snuggerud pitched in with a goal and an assist.
Blues coach Jim Montgomery sent plenty of praise his team's way after they earned their second consecutive victory to begin a five-game homestand.
"When you play this game the right way, and that was the best game we've played since the (2025 Stanley Cup) playoffs, it feels good because everybody contributed, the bench was alive," Montgomery said. "The energy on the bench was the best I've seen it in a long time and when you're doing things right, there's a saying that the hockey gods reward you."
The Blues' power play has been clicking of late, scoring in each of their previous five games (6-for-17).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Timberwolves cruise past Magic to sweep Florida road trip
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Anthony Edwards and Jaden McDaniels scored 15 points apiece, and the Minnesota Timberwolves cruised to a 115-93 win over the host Orlando Magic on Friday night.
items.body:
Anthony Edwards and Jaden McDaniels scored 15 points apiece, and the Minnesota Timberwolves cruised to a 115-93 win over the host Orlando Magic on Friday night.
Rudy Gobert added 14 points and nine rebounds for Minnesota, which won its second game in a row to start the season. Ayo Dosunmu finished with 14 points and nine assists, and LaMelo Ball chipped in 12 points.
Wendell Carter Jr. tallied 20 points and nine rebounds to lead Orlando, which dropped its second straight game under first-year head coach Sean Sweeney. Franz Wagner recorded 18 points before fouling out, and Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs finished with 14 points apiece.
Minnesota shot 42.9% (42 of 98) from the field and 37.8% (14 of 37) from 3-point range. Orlando shot 44% (37 of 84) overall but only 20.5% (8 of 39) from beyond the arc.
The Timberwolves led 57-45 at the half.
A fast start allowed Minnesota to seize a double-digit lead as early as the first quarter. Joan Beringer made a running dunk off a pass from Dosunmu to put the Timberwolves on top 24-13 with 1:05 remaining in the session.
In the second quarter, the Timberwolves increased their lead to as many as 17 points. Ball dished a pass to Edwards, who finished with a layup to make it 57-40 with 56 seconds remaining before the break.
Orlando scored the final five points of the first half on a 3-pointer by Suggs and a pair of free throws by Goga Bitadze.
The Magic fell further behind in the third quarter. They gave up a 17-3 run to finish the quarter, which ended with the Timberwolves leading 86-60.
Ball and Edwards combined for the first eight points of Minnesota's third-quarter run. Beringer added a free throw and a dunk, Dosunmu made a layup, and Trey Lyles contributed a 3-pointer and a pull-up jump shot.
The Magic trailed by double digits throughout the fourth quarter.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Scottie Barnes, RJ Barrett fuel Raptors past Wizards
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Scottie Barnes collected 28 points and 14 rebounds and RJ Barrett added 23 and nine, respectively, lifting the visiting Toronto Raptors to a 112-102 victory over the Washington Wizards on Friday.
items.body:
Scottie Barnes collected 28 points and 14 rebounds and RJ Barrett added 23 and nine, respectively, lifting the visiting Toronto Raptors to a 112-102 victory over the Washington Wizards on Friday.
Barnes made 12 of 26 shots from the floor to offset eight turnovers for the Raptors, who never trailed in the contest and improved to 2-0.
Kawhi Leonard recorded 16 points and nine rebounds and Immanuel Quickley added 12 points and six assists for Toronto.
The Raptors shot 43.6% from the floor and enjoyed a decisive 52-32 edge in points in the paint.
Trae Young highlighted his 22-point, 12-assist performance by draining four 3-pointers, with his last cutting Washington's deficit to 94-89 with 8:04 to play.
Toronto responded with an 11-3 run, with Barrett making a pair of driving layups and an 18-foot jumper in that stretch.
Washington countered by scoring five straight points before Leonard made a pair of baskets and Barnes converted a three-point play to effectively seal the win.
Kyshawn George had 11 points on 2-of-9 shooting while committing eight of the Wizards' 23 turnovers.
Washington's AJ Dybantsa, the top overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft, sat out his second straight game with a sprained left ankle as the Wizards fell to 1-1.
Barnes' dunk extended Toronto's lead to 76-66 with 2:50 remaining in the third quarter before Young sank his third 3-pointer of the evening, igniting an 11-2 run. Justin Champagnie had a pair of layups and converted an alley-oop dunk during that sequence before Jamison Battle drilled a 3-pointer just before the end of the quarter for Toronto.
The Raptors put the game on ice by outscoring the Wizards by a 31-25 margin in the fourth quarter.
George sank a pair of free throws to cut Toronto's lead to 16-11 with 4:32 remaining in the first before the Raptors responded with an 18-10 run to end the quarter. Barnes drained two jumpers and a 3-pointer during the late surge.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Hot-shooting Hawks set franchise mark with 47-point rout of Hornets
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Jalen Johnson and reserve Aaron Wiggins each scored 19 points as visiting Atlanta blew out the Charlotte Hornets 128-81 on Friday, the biggest margin of victory in Hawks history.
items.body:
Jalen Johnson and reserve Aaron Wiggins each scored 19 points as visiting Atlanta blew out the Charlotte Hornets 128-81 on Friday, the biggest margin of victory in Hawks history.
The 47-point gap topped the old record of 46 points set in a 126-80 victory over the visiting Sacramento Kings on Nov 15, 2017.
Nickeil Alexander-Walker put up 14 points, CJ McCollum posted 13 points, Dyson Daniels contributed 11 points and nine rebounds and Corey Kispert also had 11 points for Atlanta, which won its second game in a row to start the season.
Onyeka Okongwu added 10 points as the Hawks shot 50.5% from the field. Johnson supplied eight assists.
It was a miserable home opener for the Hornets, who won two nights earlier at Brooklyn to start their campaign. They committed 27 turnovers.
Naz Reid scored 17 points for Charlotte and Grayson Allen came off the bench for 11 points. Both players were in their home debuts with the Hornets. Reserve Tidjane Salaun also scored 11 points.
The Hawks were efficient on offense throughout the game.
The gap reached 97-62 by the end of the third quarter. The Hornets couldn't even get it cranked up when the margin was out of hand, needing about 6 1/2 minutes to reach a double-digit total in the fourth quarter.
Wiggins, who shot 7-for-9 from the field, hit 3 of 5 from 3-point range.
Charlotte's Brandon Miller finished 2-for-14 from the field, including 1-for-11 on 3-point tries. He scored six points.
The Hornets didn't apply much pressure, not attempting a 10th free throw until deep into the fourth quarter.
Atlanta built a 15-point first-quarter lead. It was 33-20 through the opening quarter, with the Hornets willing to fire away from the perimeter. Charlotte was 2-for-15 on first-quarter 3-point attempts.
The Hawks poured it on in the second quarter to claim a 68-43 halftime lead on the strength of Wiggins' 15 points along with 13 points apiece from Johnson and McCollum. Atlanta benefited from Charlotte's 14 first-half turnovers.
The Hornets played again without injured Kon Knueppel (hamstring), Coby White (calf) and Grant Williams (hamstring).
--Field Level Media

items.title: Police officers resign after fatal shooting of Black child in Mississippi
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: A police officer in Mississippi who fatally shot a 1-year-old Black child in a Walmart parking lot in June and the interim police chief in the city where the shooting took place have resigned, local officials said on Friday.
items.body:
A police officer in Mississippi who fatally shot a 1-year-old Black child in a Walmart parking lot in June and the interim police chief in the city where the shooting took place have resigned, local officials said on Friday.
Hunter Foster, the officer who shot the child, resigned from the Senatobia Police Department, Mayor Greg Graves said on Friday, without specifying whether he was asked to resign or did so on his own. Angelica Maze, who was the interim chief for the department, also stepped down, according to a resignation letter reported by local media.
Foster had fired his gun at a moving vehicle in response to a shoplifting call in Senatobia in June, killing 1-year-old Kohen Wiley. The fatal shooting of the child had sparked calls from civil rights advocates for accountability.
The child's family has said the shooting was not justified, but Mississippi Attorney General Lynn Fitch said this week that "the use of force was justified" and cleared the officer of criminal wrongdoing.
Although Foster was cleared, his lawyer, Martin Zummach, told NBC News that his client "resigned for the good of the city and the police department and to permit the process of healing."
Prominent civil rights attorney Ben Crump, who is representing the child's family, said they were calling for a Department of Justice investigation and that accountability cannot end at the resignation of the officer.
The Mississippi Bureau of Investigation said after the shooting in mid-June that law enforcement officers responded to a shoplifting call at Walmart and encountered two adults and a juvenile child fleeing from the store into a vehicle.
Officers attempted to stop the vehicle, but the driver drove in their direction, the bureau added, saying that an officer "then discharged their weapon and the vehicle fled the scene."
Footage released from the incident showed Foster running out of the Walmart with other officers after an employee said suspected shoplifters were attempting to flee. While officials have alleged the child's mother and her friend stole diapers, the two women have not been charged.
"No mother should have to bury her baby over an allegation of shoplifting diapers," Crump said on Friday.
Former Senatobia Police Chief Harold Vanderford was fired in September after media outlets reported he used racist slurs against Black people in text messages.

items.title: Democrat on US FCC urges broadcast industry to be more aggressive confronting the agency
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: The sole Democratic member of the Federal Communications Commission on Friday urged the broadcast industry to take a more aggressive approach in confronting the Trump administration's actions toward major US networks and stations.
items.body:
The sole Democratic member of the Federal Communications Commission on Friday urged the broadcast industry to take a more aggressive approach in confronting the Trump administration's actions toward major US networks and stations.
FCC Commissioner Anna Gomez called on the National Association of Broadcasters to address the administration's efforts to challenge broadcasters on a series of fronts, including a warning from FCC Chair Brendan Carr that US broadcast networks could violate their regulatory obligations by airing "entirely fake polls" before the November 3 election .
"This administration is running a coordinated, government-wide effort to reshape the media into its sanctioned messenger," Gomez warned, adding that Carr was seeking to pressure networks into not running polls the administration dislikes, which she said was not proper.
Carr, who has repeatedly faced pressure from President Donald Trump to crack down on US broadcasters and journalists, in April ordered an unprecedented early license review for all eight of Disney's (DIS.N) company-owned ABC TV stations.
A spokesperson for Carr did not immediately comment.
NAB President Curtis LeGeyt said in a statement that the group appreciated Gomez's "recognition of the value of local broadcasters and her commitment to the First Amendment principles that underpin a free press."
"We will continue working with her and all policymakers to protect broadcasters’ rights," he said.
Gomez said the NAB had been "largely quiet through the first year of this censorship and control campaign" but that it had not stayed "completely silent."
An "industry confronting a coordinated effort to turn licensing authority into leverage over election-year coverage needs more than a couple of tempered statements," she added.
In April, the NAB said the Disney early-renewal decision "creates significant uncertainty for all broadcasters" and argued the "FCC must be careful to avoid actions that create further instability for the local stations viewers and listeners depend on."
The FCC also said earlier this year that late-night and daytime talk shows are no longer bona fide news programs that are exempt from equal-time rules for interviews with political candidates.

items.title: Ｆ１＝ハミルトンが現役続行の可能性示唆、アフリカでのレース開催計画受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［オースティン（米テキサス州）　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［オースティン（米テキサス州）　２２日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１で個人総合優勝７回を誇るルイス・ハミルトン（英国、フェラーリ）は２２日、ルワンダでのグランプリ（ＧＰ）開催が現役生活を長く続けていく原動力になり得ると語った。

Ｆ１は１３日、２０３０年代初頭から１０年間にわたりルワンダでＧＰを開催することで合意したことを発表した。

今季の総合首位につけるキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）と共に今週末の米国ＧＰに向けた記者会見に出席したハミルトンは、アフリカＧＰの復活について、「アフリカでのレース開催が決まったことで、より長く現役を続けなければならなくなった。アフリカでレースをすることは、ずっと私の夢だった」と述べた。

来年１月に４２歳となるハミルトンは続けて、「コンディションを維持するために戦い続けなければならない。来年も良い結果を残し続けることができれば、このまま現役を続けていくつもりだ」とコメント。２０歳のアントネッリは「少なくとも最初のレースには出ないと」とハミルトンを鼓舞した。

Ｆ１史上初で唯一の黒人の王者であるハミルトンは、アフリカでのレース開催を長年にわたり訴え続けてきた。これまでの自身の取り組みについても語り、「私にとってアフリカはＧＰ開催にふさわしい場所だ。単に一つの国だけの問題ではなく、アフリカ大陸そのものにとって重要なことだ」と述べた。

WASHINGTON: The US Defense Department has designated Chinese-funded cultural centers on university campuses known as Confucius Institutes as a threat to the United States' national security, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Friday (Oct 23).
Washington has long accused Confucius Institutes of being Chinese propaganda tools and has taken steps to crack down on them.
Hegseth, in a video posted on social media, alleged that Confucius Institutes were operating under disguise at US universities and that the Pentagon had added them to its list of institutions that threaten US national security.
"It turns out that 80 new propaganda cells across 30 universities had popped up using different names and different charters, but with the same mission: to steal intellectual property and to infiltrate the minds of American students," Hegseth said.

items.title: ＥＵ、貿易赤字削減へ中国との対話重視　化学品や機械などの輸入抑制模索
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ダブリン　２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ダブリン　２３日　ロイター］ - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）の閣僚らは２３日、域内経済に打撃を与えている対中貿易赤字の削減に向けて化学品や機械などの製品の輸入を抑制することを目指し、中国政府との対話に注力すべきとの認識で一致した。

シェフチョビッチ欧州委員（通商担当）は今月、中国からのハイブリッド車の輸入を半分超削減することで中国政府と合意した。１日当たり１０億ユーロ（１１億２０００万ドル）超に膨らんだ対中貿易赤字に対処するとともに、苦境にある欧州自動車メーカーを支援する。

アイルランドのマッケンティー外相はダブリンでの閣僚会合後の会見で、欧州委員会が中国との対話を継続すべきだという点で、ＥＵ加盟国全てが一致していると説明。「ハイブリッド車以外に、化学品や機械など他の分野に目を向けたいという非常に明確な意向がある」と語った。その上で、対話が優先事項である一方、不均衡を解消するために既存の貿易防衛手段を活用することも可能だと指摘した。

シェフチョビッチ氏は、プラスチックのセーフガード（緊急輸入制限）に関する調査が次に開始される見通しだと述べた。「調査開始に必要な要件が全てそろっているかどうかを検討している」とした。

items.title: Streaking Maple Leafs, Oilers collide as Mike Babcock faces old team
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The visiting Toronto Maple Leafs will have their three-game win streak tested against the high-flying Edmonton Oilers on Saturday night.
items.body:
The visiting Toronto Maple Leafs will have their three-game win streak tested against the high-flying Edmonton Oilers on Saturday night.
The Maple Leafs edged the New York Rangers 5-4 in a back-and-forth game on Thursday. Defenseman Troy Stecher provided the unlikely game-winner with less than 30 seconds remaining in regulation for his first goal since February.
"I really liked our game," head coach Jim Hiller said. "That was probably our best game of the year through 60 minutes for me. The Rangers played good, pushed us hard, but we didn't have those lulls and dips. In fact I thought we ended up pushing and got momentum back."
Toronto's fourth line came to the rescue Thursday, combining for seven points as Brandon Duhaime and Teddy Blueger scored their first goals with the Maple Leafs. Hiller was delighted to see his depth players step up during alternate captain John Tavares' ongoing absence.
"Everybody always loves it when those guys get rewarded with goals and points because they do the dirty work, blocking shots, getting forechecks going," Hiller said. "I think that's what makes the night extra special."
If he starts again, Toronto will hope for a bounce-back performance from netminder Sergei Bobrovsky, who allowed four goals on 25 shots even as he moved into a sixth-place tie with Henrik Lundqvist in all-time wins for goaltenders. Bobrovsky, who signed a three-year, $21 million contract with the Maple Leafs in the offseason, has posted a .895 save percentage through eight games.
The Oilers sit atop the Pacific Division after a 6-5 shootout win over the defending Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes. Connor McDavid and Leon Draisaitl continued their early-season tears, combining for ten points to complete the comeback.
"I thought this was the best opportunity for our team was to play them tonight," head coach Mike Babcock said of the heavyweight bout. "For me, it was like a gift. We've got a lot of lessons there today, and then I think you build off those lessons. And we have to learn to be way more resilient. When we bend, we can't break like that. You've just got to hang in there."
The dynamic duo has combined for 68 points against the Maple Leafs in their careers and will have every reason to be optimistic against a short-handed Toronto blue line.
Edmonton, though, will be without No. 1 goaltender Devon Levi, who was placed on injured reserve Friday. It was unclear what Levi injured or when, as he finished out the shootout win against Carolina. Tristan Jarry will make his fourth start of the season against the Maple Leafs, while Matt Tomkins was recalled from the Bakersfield Condors under emergency conditions to serve as backup.
In addition to Chris Tanev (upper-body injury), Toronto will be without defenseman Nick Blankenburg, who left the game on Thursday after taking a heavy hit in the third period. Mattias Ekholm has been placed on injured reserve for the Oilers and Jason Dickinson remains sidelined.
The game will mark Babcock's first time coaching against the Maple Leafs since his contentious 2019 departure, which preceded a nearly seven-year hiatus from the NHL.
"Because they asked me," Babcock said of why he returned to the league. "So if they hadn't asked me, I'd have never done it. But when those kids asked me, they want to win and I think they should, so I'm gonna try to help."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Typhoon Champi sweeps past Taiwan, one dead and 500 injured
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Typhoon Champi swept past Taiwan on Saturday killing one person and injuring more than 500, downing trees and severing power, as it continues to weaken and head north towards the Chinese coast.
items.body:
Typhoon Champi swept past Taiwan on Saturday killing one person and injuring more than 500, downing trees and severing power, as it continues to weaken and head north towards the Chinese coast.
At one point a super typhoon and one of the strongest storms in the Pacific this year, Champi is weakening though still packing gusts of around 126 kph (78 mph) near its centre, according to Taiwan's Central Weather Administration (CWA).
The storm was about 150 km (93 miles) east of Taiwan, the CWA said, having glanced the island's northeast coast in the early hours of Saturday.
The storm's forecast track shows it is now turning north toward the Chinese coast and eventually move into southern Japan.
Taiwan's fire department said the death toll remaining at one, a man swept away by waves from the island of Liuqiu, with 527 injuries during the heavy wind and torrential rain.
Taipower said at one point more than 167,000 homes had lost electricity, though most had been reconnected.
The transport ministry said 242 flights were cancelled, though that was an improvement from Friday when the number was almost 1,000.
In the capital Taipei, there were downed trees and on-off squally rain showers.
A swathe of northern and central Taiwan, including Taipei, declared a second day of office and school closures on Saturday.
Taiwan is generally very well prepared for typhoons, which keeps casualties low. Although more common in summer, the storms can strike in autumn too.

items.title: OpenAI resumes frontier AI training after security overhaul, discloses flaw in widely used software
items.author: Reuters Staff
items.summary: OpenAI said on Friday it had resumed training of its most advanced AI models after tightening security and barring internet access, and disclosed a flaw in a widely used software.
items.body: OpenAI said on Friday it had resumed training of its most advanced AI models after tightening security and barring internet access, and disclosed a flaw in a widely used software that it found while testing its defences. The disclosure comes amid concerns over the ability of increasingly capable AI agents to identify and exploit software flaws, including in the guardrails meant to contain them. OpenAI had paused training of its most capable models after one of its research models used a configuration error to gain limited internet access in September. The company said it contained the incident and used the pause to strengthen its defences. To test them, OpenAI had teams of AI agents try to break out of their restricted environments. It said the agents found previously unknown flaws, which it had fixed, and training resumed on Oct. 1. During that exercise, the ChatGPT maker found a flaw in Brotli, a widely used data compression tool. The company said attackers could exploit the flaw by sending malicious data that lets them run their own code on affected systems, including those using popular web software such as Node.js, Bun and Envoy. OpenAI said the root cause was fixed in Brotli’s source code in February, before it was known to create a security vulnerability, but no new version was released at the time. Brotli has since released updated versions and published a public record of the flaw after OpenAI disclosed it. Separately on Thursday, AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research said they found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s internal system, including an exploit agents could have used to keep hundreds of their actions from being monitored, in a pilot review earlier this year. OpenAI told the safety organizations it has since patched all vulnerabilities affecting its production safeguards, although METR and Redwood said they had not verified the fixes. OpenAI has been conducting a broad review of its AI models’ activity since the Hugging Face incident in July, and has informed more than 100 organizations about incidents of unauthorized activity tied to its AI agents. (Reporting by Jaspreet Singh in Bengaluru, Chris Thomas in Mexico City; Editing by Pooja Desai and Stephen Coates)

German companies are increasingly viewing India as a strategic hub for manufacturing, research and development, and innovation alongside its role as a key consumer market, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has said.
Addressing the media after concluding his two-day visit here, the minister said he held a series of bilateral meetings with representatives from companies including Siemens Healthcare, Bertelsmann Investment, Volkswagen and Skoda.
"The CEOs echoed one message - German companies no longer see India only as a market, but as their partner, as a base for manufacturing, for research and development, for innovation," he said.
German precision and research, combined with India's skill and talent to innovate and manufacture for the future, and investing in the India growth story, will change the global perspective and outlook toward India, he said.
 

About 2,000 German firms currently have operations in India. The minister was here to discuss ways to boost trade and investments between the two countries.

He added that relations between the two countries open doors not just for trade in goods and services, but also open the door for talent, innovation, co-creating, co-designing, co-developing, and co-manufacturing.
"The focus of this visit has been to translate this partnership to greater levels of investment, industrial cooperation, and research and development," he said, adding that the success of the India-EU free trade agreement in the years to come will be measured by new business, new orders, greater investments, and technology partnerships.

The India-European Union trade pact would be signed by the end of this year and may be implemented next year. In January, the two sides concluded negotiations for the agreement.
"Today the greatest imperative before German industry is to cut costs and become more competitive in global markets. Therefore, they are looking at manufacturing in a much greater degree in India. As regards their innovation and their design work, almost every company tells me about existing centers, GCCs, in a big way in India, where they employ lakhs of talented young boys and girls," he said.
He said, India's over 2,100 global capability centres (GCCs) employ millions of people, with individual centres ranging from a few hundred employees to several lakh. He added that German companies are planning significant expansions, with most aiming to double or triple their operations over the next two to five years.

"That is the level of excitement about working in India... Gradually, this is obviously going to result in co-creation and co-innovation also. But I would like to go step by step. And I'd like to invite the German Institutes of Research and to come there and start working and take the next step forward for developing this partnership," he said.
India-EU FTA & CBAM:   Goyal said the European Union appreciates India's efforts to address climate change and its progress in meeting its commitments under the Paris Agreement, including exceeding its intended nationally determined contributions ahead of schedule.
He added that European countries want to partner with India in areas such as green hydrogen, financial assistance and its green initiatives.

Referring to his remarks on the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) on Thursday here at the Berlin Global Dialogue, he maintained that what he said a day earlier was completely factual.
However, he added that in the current context, Europe was ahead of many other countries on environmental issues and its partnership with India in this area was also progressing rapidly.
The minister has said that the EU is inviting "disaster" by imposing CBAM. "Who's responsible for this (climate change) mess in the first place? Where did this ozone layer get damaged? Who sent all that carbon up there?" he asked.

To this, a fellow panellist at the Dialogue said, "All of us". To this, Goyal said: "No, I'm sorry". He added, India supports 17 per cent of the world's population, and the country's contribution in global carbon emission is less than 3 per cent.
Goyal, during the talks, mentioned the 2015 Paris Agreement: "It was agreed that the developed countries, who have enjoyed the fruits of messing up the climate for so many decades, will pay a greater price and will support the developing and less developed countries. Eleven years later, we haven't seen a nickel or a dime of that. It's all promises".

He added that European countries caused the problem.
"For good reasons... you were growing, you wanted low cost of energy. You blew coal day in and day out so that your energy cost remains low," he said.
Goyal emphasised that India has one of the fastest-growing clean energy programmes.
Participation in global fairs:   When asked about the commerce ministry's plan to write to Indian Missions abroad about preparing a list of global fairs and exhibitions, Goyal said he would talk to External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar and together "we will reach out to all the missions so that we can create a buzz globally of the India story, the India strength".

Goyal said India is strengthening its presence at major international startup and technology events, with a large delegation expected to attend Finland's Slush programme and a strong Indian pavilion planned at a startup event in France.
He cited India's participation in Bharat Innovates 2026 in France and VivaTech, where it had the largest country representation.

items.title: Marquez shrugs off crash to take pole at wet Australian Grand Prix
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ducati's Marc Marquez swept to a stunning pole position at the Australian MotoGP in a wet and slippery qualifying on Saturday, with championship leader and title rival Jorge Martin finishing fourth-quickest.
items.body:
Ducati's Marc Marquez swept to a stunning pole position at the Australian MotoGP in a wet and slippery qualifying on Saturday, with championship leader and title rival Jorge Martin finishing fourth-quickest.
The conditions were treacherous at a soggy Phillip Island Grand Prix Circuit, and Marquez crashed early in the second qualifying session as he lost his front and slid off onto the grass.
The defending champion was unscathed, though, and sprinted through the Ducati garage, swapping bikes before laying down a scorching 1:34.203 to clinch his fourth pole of the season.
"I just tried to cover my big mistake! You cannot crash in the first lap, because that means that you don't have a lap time," seven-times MotoGP champion Marquez said.
"So it was a mistake on that turn four, but the team was ready with the other bike. I kept my focus, I tried to find the same feeling as I had in free practice. The last lap is the one that I did all in, and it was a good lap."
Marquez's brother Alex of Gresini Racing took second, while LCR Honda's Johann Zarco completed the front row.
Frenchman Zarco had come through the first qualifying session earlier on Saturday and capitalised on his knowledge of the shifting conditions.
"It was stressful," Zarco said.
"You think it's raining so you cannot switch to the medium, but then you go out and it is not raining anymore, and with the wind it's getting dry!"
Aprilia's Martin will start from the second row in both Saturday's sprint and Sunday's race, giving Marquez a shot at overtaking him in the standings.
With five rounds remaining in the season, including the Australian MotoGP, just two points separate the top two riders in the championship, with Martin on 355 and Marquez on 353.
Martin's teammate Marco Bezzecchi, who was ninth-quickest in qualifying, is a somewhat distant third on 309.
Earlier on Saturday, Australian rider Jack Miller of Pramac Racing topped the first qualifying session, much to the delight of home fans.
Sunday's race will be MotoGP's last [USN:L6N46607H TEXT:"at Phillip Island,"] with the Australian Grand Prix moving to the streets of Adelaide next year.

items.title: Duke QB Walker Eget returns after apparent hand injury vs. Virginia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Duke quarterback Walker Eget returned to begin the second half of Friday night's game at Virginia after leaving on the team's first possession with an apparent hand injury at Charlottesville, Va.
items.body:
Duke quarterback Walker Eget returned to begin the second half of Friday night's game at Virginia after leaving on the team's first possession with an apparent hand injury at Charlottesville, Va.
The transfer from San Jose State missed the rest of the first half after the opening possession, which resulted in a Duke touchdown.
Backup quarterback Dan Mahan played into the second quarter. Eget completed both of his first-quarter pass attempts for 43 yards before leaving.
Eget entered the game completing 62.8% of his passes for 1,229 yards with eight touchdowns and two interceptions this season.
Virginia led 13-7 at halftime.
--Field Level Media

items.title: OpenAI bloquea el acceso a internet de sus modelos de IA más avanzados durante el entrenamiento
items.author: Rachel Metz
items.summary: La decisión llega tras incidentes en los que modelos de IA de OpenAI lograron conectarse a la web y vulnerar la seguridad de sistemas de terceros, incluida la plataforma Hugging Face.
items.body: Bloomberg — OpenAI comenzó a bloquear el acceso a Internet de sus modelos de inteligencia artificial más avanzados durante el proceso de entrenamiento, como respuesta a incidentes anteriores en los que sus sistemas vulneraron la seguridad de otras empresas. La empresa afirmó el viernes en una entrada de blog que, tras una pausa el mes pasado, había reanudado el entrenamiento de sus modelos más avanzados, pero que tiene la intención de bloquear el acceso a Internet hasta que considere que dispone de las medidas de seguridad adecuadas para mitigar el riesgo de que los modelos aún no publicados puedan llevar a cabo acciones no autorizadas en línea durante el entrenamiento. “Teniendo en cuenta el estado actual de la investigación sobre alineación, los sistemas de supervisión y la seguridad de la infraestructura de Internet, creemos que el enfoque responsable consiste en llevar a cabo el entrenamiento de modelos de vanguardia sin acceso a Internet”, escribió la empresa. Ver más: OpenAI apuntaría a una valoración de US$1,25 billones en nueva ronda de US$30.000 millones A finales de septiembre, la empresa anunció que suspendería el entrenamiento de sus modelos de IA más avanzados tras descubrir que uno de sus sistemas de agentes de IA, que se estaba entrenando en lo que se suponía que era un entorno seguro y sin conexión a Internet, había logrado acceder a la web para conectarse con un chatbot externo de terceros. En aquel momento, OpenAI describió esta fuga como el primer incidente de seguridad de este tipo desde que, en julio, una combinación de modelos obtuviera acceso a Internet durante unas pruebas internas y violara inadvertidamente la seguridad de la plataforma de IA Hugging Face. Los modelos implicados en la filtración involuntaria de Hugging Face funcionaban sin las medidas de seguridad habituales, según ha declarado la empresa, ya que OpenAI tenía la intención de que permanecieran en un área de pruebas conocida como sandbox —esencialmente, un entorno de software virtual aislado destinado a realizar pruebas de seguridad o analizar código inseguro de forma controlada—. Sin embargo, los modelos lograron escapar de ese sandbox aprovechando una vulnerabilidad del software para acceder a Internet. Ver más: OpenAI se compromete a no usar secretos comerciales de Apple durante una audiencia clave OpenAI ha señalado que, tras el incidente de Hugging Face, redujo las conexiones a través de las cuales sus modelos podían acceder a Internet durante el entrenamiento y las pruebas, aunque mantuvo algunas con fines de métricas, registro y autenticación. Asimismo, dedicó una enorme cantidad de potencia de cálculo a encargar a sistemas de IA agentiva la identificación de vulnerabilidades en sus entornos de entrenamiento, como parte de una iniciativa de “red teaming”, una expresión que suele utilizarse para describir los intentos deliberados de infiltrarse en sistemas con el fin de descubrir vulnerabilidades antes de que lo hagan los atacantes reales. “Nuestros agentes del “red team” detectaron vulnerabilidades en casi todos estos servicios que les proporcionaban formas limitadas de acceso a Internet", señaló la empresa en su publicación. Ver más: OpenAI se disculpa por hackeo en Australia y promete informar más rápido sobre estos casos La empresa señaló que, desde entonces, ha implementado parches de software, ha impuesto restricciones de red más estrictas y ha comunicado los hallazgos a los proveedores. En los últimos meses se han producido una serie de revelaciones por parte de OpenAI y de sus competidores, entre ellos Anthropic PBC, sobre incidentes en los que sus modelos llevaron a cabo ataques autónomos o acciones no autorizadas en sitios web y sistemas de terceros. Estos casos, junto con una serie de severas advertencias procedentes del propio sector, han situado el debate sobre la seguridad en el centro de la atención pública. Los desarrolladores de IA han advertido de que sus sistemas podrían llegar pronto a ser demasiado sofisticados para que las personas puedan controlarlos, lo que se suma a la preocupación de que la tecnología pueda ser utilizada por actores humanos malintencionados para crear armas biológicas o llevar a cabo ciberataques devastadores. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: UK's Healey to give two state-backed lenders £20 billion capital boost in budget
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British finance minister John Healey is expected to announce £20.4 billion ($27.3 billion) of additional support to the state's business lender and infrastructure bank in his budget on Wednesday, the Treasury said, confirming a newspaper report.
items.body:
British finance minister John Healey is expected to announce £20.4 billion ($27.3 billion) of additional support to the state's business lender and infrastructure bank in his budget on Wednesday, the Treasury said, confirming a newspaper report.
The Treasury will allocate £15.4 billion ($20.6 billion) more to the National Wealth Fund and £5 billion ($7 billion) more to the British Business Bank over roughly half a decade
"This additional capital will help more British businesses fulfil their potential, while getting investment behind the industries, infrastructure and places that create good jobs and drive lasting growth across the country," a Treasury spokesperson said in an emailed statement
The Treasury said the funding would help support around 100,000 jobs by 2035 in sectors including artificial intelligence, defence and green energy
The Financial Times first reported the news
($1 = 0.7478 pounds)

items.title: Iran has detailed plans to hit Gulf undersea cables if war resumes, officials say
items.author: CNA

Iran has detailed plans to hit Gulf undersea cables if war resumes, officials say

Their comments followed warnings by Iranian officials that undersea cables in the region could become targets in any renewed conflict if diplomacy with Washington collapses.

DUBAI: Tehran has drawn up detailed plans to target undersea communications cables in the Gulf if the United States and Israel attack Iran again, two senior Iranian security officials told Reuters.
Their comments followed warnings by Iranian officials that undersea cables in the region could become targets in any renewed conflict if diplomacy with Washington collapses.
The two Iranian security officials, speaking on condition of anonymity, gave few details and did not say how or where exactly Tehran would carry out such attacks. But one of them said Iran would aim to prevent repairs after any attacks to prolong disruptions to communications, including internet connections.
"If Iran is attacked, there will be no more red lines ... from undersea cables to military bases, including covert ones," one of the officials said.

The official warned Washington not to "play with fire", and said Iran had full access to the undersea cables and could easily destroy them.
Yadollah Javani, the deputy head of political affairs for Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC), said on Wednesday (Oct 21) that Iran could target seven major internet cables beneath the Strait of Hormuz if Iranian infrastructure came under attack.
Undersea cables carry around 99 per cent of global internet traffic, according to the International Telecommunication Union, a UN agency. But the global impact of such attacks by Iran could be limited as less than 1 per cent of international bandwidth passes through the Strait of Hormuz, said Alan Mauldin, research director at telecommunications research firm TeleGeography.
The strait separates Iran and Oman, linking the Gulf to the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea.
The US Department of State and Iran's Foreign Ministry did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment on the Iranian security officials' remarks. There was no immediate comment from Gulf states.

Related:

US could strike Iran this weekend, envoy says

US orders diplomats to depart Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes

"STRONGER RESPONSE" The plans for possible attacks on undersea cables reflect a conviction in Iran's leadership that a renewed US military campaign would have to be met with a stronger response than before.
Top security official Mohsen Rezaei warned this month that US-linked digital infrastructure across the Gulf, including data centres and AI facilities, could be targeted in a renewed conflict.
Washington's Gulf allies have invested heavily in such infrastructure and they "should hold Washington, not Tehran, responsible for any damage to undersea cables," the second Iranian security official said.
Alex Vatanka, director of the Iran program at the Middle East Institute in Washington, said such threats were intended to deter renewed conflict and put pressure on Washington by making Gulf governments and US companies fear for their investments in the region.
"Tehran wants Gulf states and corporate executives to press (US President Donald) Trump over the risks his policies pose to their investment plans," said Vatanka.
Multiple cable cuts could slow internet services and disrupt financial transactions, e-commerce and cloud computing, analysts said. The impact would depend on how operators rerouted traffic and the capacity available on alternative connections, Mauldin said.
Restoring connections during wartime could be difficult, experts said, and higher insurance costs and delays in obtaining permits to enter territorial waters could further complicate repairs.
The Red Sea could offer a more significant target than the Strait of Hormuz, particularly if Iran had support from its Houthi allies in Yemen, though Tehran has made no public statement indicating it plans to target cables there.
The Red Sea carries data between Europe, East Africa and Asia, with capacity routed through it accounting for about 3 per cent of global international demand and around 10 per cent of traffic travelling between regions, Mauldin said.
Gulf governments have been investing heavily in technology to diversify beyond oil and become global artificial intelligence hubs, deepening ties with US technology firms.
Iranian strikes directly hit two Amazon Web Services facilities in the UAE in March and damaged infrastructure near one of its facilities in Bahrain. The IRGC named US tech companies including Microsoft, Google, Apple and Nvidia as legitimate targets at the height of the war in March.
Land-based connections can provide alternative routes for internet traffic, and Gulf states and US technology companies are investing in additional infrastructure to improve resilience.
Microsoft plans to invest more than US$400 million in subsea and terrestrial connectivity across the Middle East by 2030.

Source: Reuters/gs

The Red Sea carries data between Europe, East Africa and Asia, with capacity routed through it accounting for about 3 per cent of global international demand and around 10 per cent of traffic travelling between regions, Mauldin said.
Gulf governments have been investing heavily in technology to diversify beyond oil and become global artificial intelligence hubs, deepening ties with US technology firms.
Iranian strikes directly hit two Amazon Web Services facilities in the UAE in March and damaged infrastructure near one of its facilities in Bahrain. The IRGC named US tech companies including Microsoft, Google, Apple and Nvidia as legitimate targets at the height of the war in March.
Land-based connections can provide alternative routes for internet traffic, and Gulf states and US technology companies are investing in additional infrastructure to improve resilience.
Microsoft plans to invest more than US$400 million in subsea and terrestrial connectivity across the Middle East by 2030.

items.title: Blakely wins world all-around title after injury setbacks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: American Skye Blakely won the women's all-around title at the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships on Friday, completing a comeback from an Achilles injury that derailed her bid for the 2024 Paris Olympics.
items.body:
American Skye Blakely won the women's all-around title at the World Artistic Gymnastics Championships on Friday, completing a comeback from an Achilles injury that derailed her bid for the 2024 Paris Olympics.
The 21-year-old scored 55.733 points across vault, uneven bars, balance beam and floor exercise at Ahoy Arena to claim her first individual world title. Russia's Liudmila Roshchina took silver with 55.199, while China's Ke Qinqin, 16, finished third on 55.032.
Blakely ruptured her right Achilles tendon during floor exercise training two days before the US Olympic trials in 2024, ending her bid to qualify for the Paris Games. She had also missed the Tokyo Olympic trials in 2021 after tearing an elbow ligament.
The victory marks a breakthrough for Blakely, who previously won team gold at the 2022 and 2023 world championships but had not earned an individual world medal.
She became the first American woman to win the world all-around title since Simone Biles in 2023.

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ［オースティン（米テキサス州）　２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［オースティン（米テキサス州）　２３日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の今季第１８戦、米国グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２３日、米テキサス州オースティンでフリー走行を行い、フェラーリのシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）がこの日のトップタイムを記録した。

フリー走行１回目に最速１分３６秒０５２を記録したルクレールは、２回目でトップタイムの１分３５秒２９１をマークした。

今週末の結果次第でＦ１史上最年少王者となるメルセデスのキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア）が０秒０４２差で２番手。昨年の米国ＧＰを制したレッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）がルクレールと０秒１８９差で３番手に入った。

４番手はフェラーリのルイス・ハミルトンで、メルセデスのジョージ・ラッセル（ともに英国）が５番手で続いた。現王者でマクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）は、レーシングブルズのリアム・ローソン（ニュージーランド）に続く７番手となった。

items.title: US has for years asked Musk to alter Starlink service in Ukraine, Middle East, sources say
items.author: Erin Banco, Joey Roulette
items.creator: Erin Banco, Joey Roulette
items.summary: The Biden-era and Trump requests to Musk show a close relationship in which US administrations rely to an unprecedented degree on a private-sector company to help implement foreign policy.
items.body:
Well before the throttling this month of Ukraine's military access to Elon Musk's satellite communications system, the Biden and Trump administrations had several times asked SpaceX to turn its Starlink service on or off in various countries, according to six former senior US officials familiar with the matter.
During the presidency of Joe Biden, the requests included switching off the service to prevent Iranian proxy militias in Yemen and Lebanon from using Starlink to communicate, and activating the service to provide internet access inside Iran and in Ukraine to support its military, said four of the former officials.
Similarly, President Donald Trump's administration asked Musk, who is CEO of SpaceX, to make the service available in Iran following US-Israeli strikes in 2025 and 2026, in hopes it would bolster internet access and communications for anti-government protesters, a former senior Trump official and a person familiar with the matter told Reuters.
All of the people spoke on condition of anonymity. The previous US requests about Starlink access are being reported here for the first time.
The recent blowup over restrictions to Ukraine's use of SpaceX satellite services has raised questions about the ties between the US government and Musk, whose company owns systems vital to the US military and to US allies.
The Biden-era and Trump requests to Musk show a close relationship in which US administrations rely to an unprecedented degree on a private-sector company to help implement foreign policy.
The recent limits on Ukraine, despite being a US ally, have also rattled officials in Europe, some of whom argue that Europe must develop its own military satellite communications capabilities because no viable short-term alternative currently exists.
STARSHIELD RESTRICTIONS HOBBLE UKRAINE MILITARY Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said last week that his country's access to Starshield, the military version of the Starlink system, had been intentionally limited, interfering with the performance of the country’s military drones. He also said the speeds were reduced for Starlink, which Ukraine uses for some military activities including defense against Russian missile attacks.
Reuters has reported that [USN:L1N4610ZC TEXT:"the order to throttle Starshield"] came from inside the White House. The Trump administration has acknowledged the slowdown but has not said whether it gave the order.
The White House, contacted for comment, referred Reuters to Trump's remarks on Friday, when he said he had not spoken with Musk about Starlink access issues for Ukraine and that "if there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out."
Halyna Yusypiuk, a spokesperson for the Ukrainian embassy in Washington, said Ukraine's priority is "to have the service restored to normal speed as soon as possible, as the lives of our people depend on it."
SpaceX did not respond to requests for comment, although Musk said in a social media post earlier this week: “Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately (by the president of the United States).”
Democratic US Representative Jason Crow called on Friday for clarity about the recent changes to Ukraine's satellite service, saying there are risks to the US dependence on SpaceX.
"Unelected billionaires and private corporations should not decide what is in the best interest of America's national security," Crow said.
For Ukraine, the Starlink internet service has become the lifeblood of frontline communication between units, who say there is currently no rival to the capabilities of SpaceX's products.
Starshield receivers, largely impervious to radio jamming, are used as onboard guidance systems and to provide links to a remote pilot for Ukrainian drones, including deep behind Russian lines inside Ukraine.
MUSK'S INFLUENCE RAISES UNCERTAINTY Musk's role as the strong-willed CEO of a company with outsized influence over US national security has at times raised questions over who is making decisions about SpaceX's satellite services.
The SpaceX CEO is "supposed to be a business executive, with government contracts, and he's essentially making huge foreign policy decisions," said Armand Musey, president of Summit Ridge Group, a satellite industry consultancy.
"He's sufficiently ambiguous of a person that you don't know if his decisions are sort of his personal quirks, or it's because there's an influence elsewhere that's impacting him," Musey said.
In previous years, Musk has moved to limit Ukraine’s access to Starlink. In 2022, according to Reuters reporting , Musk ordered SpaceX personnel to cut Starlink coverage in areas Ukraine was trying to retake, a move that surprised White House officials.
Musk has said publicly that he refused a 2022 Ukrainian request to activate his satellite network in Crimea's port city of Sevastopol to aid an attack on Russia's fleet there, saying he feared complicity in a major act of war.
The Biden administration at times relied on Musk to help implement policy, five of the former officials said.
Biden officials coordinated with SpaceX to thwart US adversaries by cutting the service, and to help allies by expanding Starlink’s availability, they said.
They added that discussions between the government and SpaceX, which usually included Pentagon and White House officials, often focused on preventing groups such as the Iranian-linked Houthis in Yemen and Hezbollah in Lebanon from using Starlink terminals.
Biden officials several times shared intelligence with SpaceX that indicated that the Houthis and Hezbollah were using diverted Starlink terminals — hardware that made its way to the militants through intermediaries.
In October 2023, during fighting between Israel and Hezbollah militants in southern Lebanon, intelligence officials told the White House that individuals linked to Hezbollah could have gained access to Starlink terminals. Officials had similar concerns about the Houthis in Yemen in 2024 during a US air campaign against the Iran-linked group, five of the officials said.
In both cases, the administration contacted SpaceX and asked it to identify the terminals and shut them off. At least some of the terminals were deactivated, said two of the officials.
In a 2024 submission to the US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security, SpaceX said it works closely with US government agencies to secure export authorizations where required and to safeguard technology in support of US national security objectives and foreign policy goals.
Soon after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Biden officials pushed SpaceX to expand Starlink use for the Ukrainian military, said two of the former officials.
In a separate instance, the Biden administration asked SpaceX to turn on Starlink in Iran during a protest movement launched in September 2022 after the death of Mahsa Amini, an Iranian arrested for not wearing her hijab properly, according to one of the former officials.
Starlink terminals were moved into the country with the help of the administration, said the official, who declined to say how many were transferred.
The Trump administration took a similar step earlier this year and discussed with Musk and SpaceX getting Starlink terminals into Iran and activated following US-Israeli strikes in the country in June 2025 and again in February 2026, a former senior Trump official and a person familiar with the matter told Reuters.
Neither the Trump administration nor SpaceX has publicly confirmed that those terminals were turned on. The Wall Street Journal reported in February that the US government had sent thousands of Starlink terminals into Iran.
Iran's delegation to the UN did not respond to a request for comment.

items.title: サッカー＝伊藤所属バイエルンのコンパニ監督、練習中に倒れ病院に搬送
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ミュンヘン（ドイツ）　２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ミュンヘン（ドイツ）　２３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガで伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンは２３日、バンサン・コンパニ監督が練習中に倒れ、病院に搬送されたと発表した。

コンパニ監督は最近、ウイルス感染症を患い、チームの練習を何度か欠席していた。クラブの発表によると、同監督はセカンドチームの練習を見学中に倒れ、医療処置を受けた。現在は病院で精密検査を受けており、引き続き医師の管理下に置かれる。当面はコーチ陣が練習や試合の指揮を執るという。

バイエルンはドイツ１部で首位に立っており、今週行われた欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）ではアーセナル（イングランド）とホームで２─２の引き分け。２５日には鈴木唯人、山本理仁、後藤啓介が所属するフライブルクと敵地で対戦する予定となっている。

items.title: Los disturbios disparan las ventas de armas de autodefensa en las ciudades más afectadas de Francia
items.author: Angelina Rascouet
items.summary: Los comerciantes franceses refuerzan la seguridad de sus negocios ante una nueva jornada de disturbios. Las ventas de armas de autodefensa se han multiplicado por diez en las ciudades más afectadas.
items.body: Bloomberg — A última hora de la mañana del viernes, Sam salió de una tienda de caza en el centro de París, tras haber gastado EUR$600 (US$671) en armas destinadas a la autodefensa. El tendero, que se negó a dar su apellido por motivos de seguridad, es propietario de una joyería de bisutería en Les Halles, un extenso distrito comercial. Su negocio se libró de los alborotadores que saquearon las tiendas cercanas el pasado fin de semana, pero quiere estar preparado por si se producen nuevos episodios de violencia. Ver más: Francia desplegará militares para contener nuevas protestas este fin de semana Entre sus compras figuraban una porra, así como una pistola de plástico que dispara pequeños cartuchos de una sustancia similar al gas lacrimógeno. A diferencia de lo que ocurre en gran parte de Estados Unidos, la compra de armas de fuego en Francia está estrictamente restringida. Sam también ha contratado a guardias de seguridad privados con perros y está tapiando sus escaparates. A pesar de sus preocupaciones, tiene previsto abrir el negocio. “Nunca pensé que se llegaría a esto”, afirmó. “Estoy tomando estas medidas, pero no me siento tranquilo”. Las protestas del pasado sábado en toda Francia degeneraron en actos de vandalismo y violencia, cuando grupos itinerantes de alborotadores atacaron cientos de tiendas, rompiendo escaparates y llevándose la mercancía. Desde entonces, los disturbios se han calmado, pero dado que los manifestantes han convocado otra jornada de disturbios para este sábado, los residentes, las autoridades y los comerciantes están en vilo. Sam compró su equipo en l’Armurerie de la Bourse, cuyo propietario, Yves Gollety, preside la organización que representa a los vendedores de armas en toda Francia —un cargo que le proporciona una perspectiva nacional—. Ver más: Macron acusa a líderes extranjeros de aprovecharse de los disturbios en Francia Su tienda está registrando unos niveles de actividad extraordinarios, según afirmó, y no es la única. Gollety, que suele atender a cazadores y tiradores deportivos, calcula que las ventas de armas para la autodefensa se han multiplicado por diez en las ciudades que han sufrido los mayores disturbios, como París, Marsella, Lyon y Burdeos. “La gente quedó traumatizada por lo ocurrido el pasado fin de semana, cuando en ocasiones se vieron solos, a veces durante dos o tres horas o incluso todo el día, enfrentándose a los alborotadores”, explicó Gollety. “Los comerciantes, los propietarios de restaurantes y los particulares se asustaron y buscan defenderse. No pretenden tomarse la justicia por su mano”. Si bien las ventas tradicionales de rifles de caza se han desplomado, la demanda de sprays de pimienta, botes similares al gas lacrimógeno, pistolas que disparan balas de goma y otros equipos no letales se ha disparado. El aumento de las ventas no tiene “precedentes”, señaló Gollety, y es más pronunciado que en episodios anteriores de disturbios y agitación social. La tienda de Gollety estuvo abierta el sábado pasado, pero no sufrió daños, a pesar de que otros comercios de la zona fueron atacados y saqueados. Tiene previsto abrir mañana, aunque solo sea para proteger su tienda. Ver más: Violencia en Francia eleva las alertas en Europa ante nuevas protestas y elecciones La Prefectura de Policía instó a los propietarios de negocios a contratar a más agentes de seguridad privada antes del sábado, lo que provocó la ira de muchos, entre ellos Eric Larcheveque, cofundador de Ledger, fabricante de carteras de hardware para criptomonedas. Este escribió en X que, si el Estado ya no puede proteger a la población, los franceses deberían dejar de pagar impuestos. -Con la colaboración de Julius Domoney. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: サッカー＝サウジでのアジア杯開催、治安情勢受け困難か　宮本会長が見解
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［東京　２３日　ロイター］ - 日本サッカー協会の宮本恒靖会長は２３日、サウジアラビアの治安情勢を踏まえ、来年のアジア・カップ（杯）を予定通り同国で開催するのは容易ではないとの認識を示した。

サウジではイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃が激化する中、主要なスポーツイベントの中止や延期が相次いでいる。来年１月７日から２月５日まで予定されているアジア杯の開催にも不透明感が広がっている。

宮本会長は東京で開かれたアジア・サッカー連盟（ＡＦＣ）の臨時総会で記者団に対し、報道を通じて把握している限りでは現地の安全が確保されておらず、現時点での開催は難しいとの見方を示した。

また、サウジ側との会談では、選手やファン、大会関係者らの安全を最優先する方針が伝えられたと説明。サウジ側からは、開催の可否をＡＦＣと協議して判断するため、結論が出るまでには時間がかかるとの説明もあったという。

ＡＦＣ会長は先週、必要であれば大会を２０２８年に延期する可能性もあると述べたが、その後、地元大会組織委員会は当初の日程通り開催する方針を示していた。

items.title: Tyrrell Hatton, Ian Poulter join LIV Golf exodus
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: LIV Golf lost two more big-name players, with Englishmen Tyrrell Hatton and Ian Poulter announcing Friday they will not sign on for LIV 2.0.
items.body:
LIV Golf lost two more big-name players, with Englishmen Tyrrell Hatton and Ian Poulter announcing Friday they will not sign on for LIV 2.0.
Hatton, 35, posted a brief statement to Instagram announcing his decision.
"Wanted to confirm that I will not be a part of LIV 2.0," he wrote.
"A big thank you to everyone for continued support," he continued. "I am excited for what the next chapter of my career holds."
Hatton joined LIV in 2024 and had one tournament win -- LIV Nashville that same year. He was part of captain Jon Rahm's Legion XIII, winner of the 2025 season championship.
Poulter, 50, said he made his decision after discussing his playing future with his family and team.
"Ultimately, the opportunity to spend more time at home with my family, reduce international travel, focus on senior golf and have the opportunity to pursue other interests was something that I felt was right for me at this stage of my life and career," Poulter said in an Instagram post.
Poulter was among the first players to sign with LIV Golf at its inception in 2022. He and countryman Lee Westwood have been two of the most outspoken supporters of the Saudi-backed league, which has been accused by many critics of dividing the professional golf world.
Poulter and Westwood served as the co-captains of the all-English Majesticks GC that included Laurie Canter and Sam Horsfield for the 2026 season. Majesticks finished 12th in the 13-team league.
Tom McKibbin added his name to the list later Friday when he announced his decision to play full-time on the DP World Tour going forward.
The 23-year-old native of Northern Ireland, who counts Rory McIlroy as a countryman and mentor, won one DP World Tour event before joining Rahm and Legion XIII in 2025.
"Joining LIV Golf was the right decision for me at the time, and I'm grateful for everything it has given me," McKibbin wrote on Instagram. "... I've taken time to think about what's best for me and I am confident (returning to the DP World Tour) is the right decision to help me achieve my goals."
Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund announced earlier this year that it would end its financial support of LIV Golf. CEO Scott O'Neil has lined up funding for LIV 2.0 as the league goes through Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings, with plans to play a 10-event schedule in 2027 that includes five events in the United States and five internationally.
However, Hatton, Poulter and McKibbin join a growing list of players who will not return that includes Rahm, Sergio Garcia and David Puig of Spain, as well as Abraham Ancer, Charles Howell III, Adrian Meronk, Louis Oosthuizen and Thomas Pieters. Other marquee names, including Bryson DeChambeau, Cam Smith and Joaquin Niemann, have not declared yet what they intend to do by Sunday's registration deadline.
"Clearly, LIV Golf has divided opinion," Poulter wrote. "But to be part of the founding group that took world class golf around the globe, showcased our great game to a new audience, built a team brand in Majesticks GC, helped innovate tournament formats and establish a leading community impact program in Little Sticks, is something I will be forever proud of. And that's just scratching the surface of what we achieved together.
"Change is never easy and it's fair to say professional golf has experienced plenty of it over the last few years. But I've always believed that change can create opportunity and ultimately lead to positive outcomes. There will undoubtedly be more changes ahead, but I am confident the game will continue to grow, evolve, and deliver the very best for golf fans around the world."
Poulter will likely need to serve a one-year suspension from the date of his most recent LIV event before being eligible to play on the Champions Tour, similar to former LIV player Henrik Stenson, who made his Champions debut earlier this year.
The DP World Tour has also announced it will not grant membership to LIV Golf players in 2027, which Poulter needs in order to be eligible to be a Ryder Cup captain or vice captain for Europe in the future.
Meanwhile, Poulter's eldest son, Luke, 22, plays golf for the University of Florida and has competed in the Walker Cup. Joshua Poulter, 14, is his youngest son. Ian and his wife, Katie, also have two daughters.
He said he plans to devote more time to helping Luke and Joshua in their golf pursuits and also growing his YouTube channel.
"I'm genuinely excited about this next chapter. I'm looking forward to spending more time with my family, continuing to develop The Postman YouTube channel, sharing more of my life, golf, experiences and competing in some senior events," Poulter wrote. "Something I am also particularly looking forward to is being able to spend more time helping Luke as he pursues his career in professional golf, and Joshua as he looks to develop as a golfer in his teenage years. Having spent so many years travelling the world chasing my own golfing dreams, the opportunity to now spend more time supporting my boys as they chase theirs is something that means a great deal to me.
"After all these years, golf has given me so much, and I'm excited about what lies ahead, both on and off the course. Thanks again to everyone who has been part of the journey so far! We certainly aren't done yet!"
--Field Level Media

items.title: フランス格下げ回避、ムーディーズが据え置き決定　社会不安続く中
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［パリ　２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［パリ　２３日　ロイター］ - 格付け会社ムーディーズは２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いた。社会不安の抑制と厳しい財政の立て直しに苦慮する政府にとって、圧力が和らいだ格好だ。

ムーディーズは格付けの定期見直しを終え、「Ａａ３」に据え置いたと発表した。見通しは２０２５年１０月以降、「ネガティブ」としている。

債券市場は格下げを織り込んでいた。格下げされれば、既に格下げしていたＳ＆Ｐ、フィッチにムーディーズも足並みをそろえる形になるところだった。フランスでは２４年の解散総選挙でどの勢力も議会の過半数を確保できず、政治がまひ状態に陥り、財政再建が難航している。

仏財務省は声明で、格付け据え置きは「政府が２７年予算法案で示した予算の信頼性を反映している。この予算は、財政再建の軌道を維持することを目指している」と表明した。

ムーディーズは声明で「Ａａ３の格付けは、財政赤字の削減を盛り込んだ２７年予算が成立し、今後数カ月で資金調達コストが幾分低下し、社会的緊張もやや緩和することを前提としている」と説明した。

items.title: Legendary Rams RB Lawrence McCutcheon dies at 76
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Legendary Los Angeles Rams running back Lawrence McCutcheon died Friday after a battle with Parkinson's disease. He was 76.
items.body:
Legendary Los Angeles Rams running back Lawrence McCutcheon died Friday after a battle with Parkinson's disease. He was 76.
McCutcheon was a Pro Bowl selection in five straight seasons (1973-77) for the Rams and still ranks fourth all-time on the club's rushing list with 6,186 yards over eight seasons from 1972-79.
McCutcheon was the franchise's leading rusher when his Los Angeles career ended. He now ranks behind Marshall Faulk (6,959), Eric Dickerson (7,245) and Steven Jackson (10,138) on the club's list.
"It is with great sadness that we share the passing of our husband, brother, father, grandfather, and great grandfather, Lawrence McCutcheon," McCutcheon's family said in a statement. "Clutch passed away on October 23 with family at his bedside following a long, courageous battle with Parkinson's disease.
"Through a decade-long playing career and another 32 years in the Rams' front office, Clutch earned the respect and admiration of teammates, opposing players, colleagues, and fans alike. Clutch will be missed and remembered forever. We are thankful to those in our community who have reached out with love and support."
McCutcheon finished his playing career with the Denver Broncos (1980), Seattle Seahawks (1980) and Buffalo Bills (1981). Overall, he rushed for 6,578 yards and 26 touchdowns and caught 198 passes for 1,799 yards and 13 scores in 109 career games (82 starts).
McCutcheon participated in 11 playoff games for the Rams and famously threw a 24-yard touchdown pass to Ron Smith in the third quarter of Super Bowl XIV. That gave Los Angeles a 19-17 lead before it eventually lost 31-19 to the Pittsburgh Steelers on Jan. 20, 1980.
McCutcheon was a third-round pick in 1972 out of Colorado State, also known as the Rams. He played at Colorado State from 1969-71 and still ranks seventh all-time in rushing yards (2,917). McCutcheon was inducted into the Colorado State Athletics Hall of Fame in 1989.
After his playing career, McCutcheon returned to the Rams as a scout in 1982 and served in many roles -- including director of player personnel for seven years -- before retiring in 2016.
"The Los Angeles Rams are deeply saddened by the passing of Lawrence McCutcheon," the team said in a statement. "His impact on this organization spanned generations, and he embodied what it means to be a Ram. A five-time Pro Bowl running back and once the franchise's all-time leading rusher, he later served in our front office as a scout and director of player personnel. His legacy is woven into the fabric of our team. We extend our heartfelt condolences to the McCutcheon family as we celebrate a life that gave so much to the Rams and to our game."
Cornerback Daylon McCutcheon, the son of Lawrence, was a member of the Cleveland Browns from 1999-2006.
McCutcheon's family asked that, in lieu of flowers, those wishing to honor him please donate to the Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Líder da Coreia do Norte pede “revolução militar” ao exigir unidades militares mais fortes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O líder norte-coreano Kim Jong Un pediu que as companhias do Exército do país fossem transformadas em unidades de combate de elite e autossuficientes durante uma reunião de dois dias de comandantes de companhia em Pyongyang, informou a agência de notícias estatal KCNA no sábado (horário local).
items.body:
O líder norte-coreano Kim Jong Un pediu que as companhias do Exército do país fossem transformadas em unidades de combate de elite e autossuficientes durante uma reunião de dois dias de comandantes de companhia em Pyongyang, informou a agência de notícias estatal KCNA no sábado (horário local).
O evento ressaltou a prioridade política consistente de Kim de fortalecer as Forças Armadas.
Em um discurso proferido na conferência de comandantes de companhias do Exército da Coreia do Norte, realizada nos dias 22 e 23 de outubro — que, segundo a KCNA, foi o primeiro encontro de todo o Exército desde o 9º Congresso do partido governista da Coreia do Norte, em fevereiro —, Kim pediu que todas as companhias se preparassem plenamente para que “a meta do fortalecimento militar da nova era” pudesse ser alcançada.
“Vamos tornar o Exército mais forte e acelerar uma revolução militar ao nosso estilo”, disse Kim.
Durante o 9º Congresso do partido governista da Coreia do Norte, em fevereiro — que define os rumos do país para os próximos cinco anos —, Kim pediu o fortalecimento das Forças Armadas convencionais, além de reafirmar os esforços para desenvolver armas nucleares e mísseis.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２３日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのＢＭＷ女子選手権は２３日、韓国南西部・海南のパインビーチ・リンクス（パー７２）で第２ラウンドを行い、岩井千怜と吉田優利が通算９アンダーの１３５で６位につけた。

前日首位の吉田は４バーディー、１ボギーの６９で回り、６位に後退。首位とは４打差となった。８位スタートだった岩井千怜は２イーグル、５バーディー、１ボギー、１ダブルボギーの６６をマークした。

２９位で出た岩井明愛は６７で回り、通算６アンダーの１３８で１５位に浮上。前日１８位の畑岡奈紗は６９をマークし、通算５アンダーの１３９で２３位に後退した。

勝みなみは４５位、古江彩佳は５６位、竹田麗央は７５位、原英莉花は８０位だった。

ユ・ヘラン（韓国）が２イーグル、４バーディーの６４、通算１３アンダーの１３１として首位に浮上。ローレン・コフリン（米国）らが２打差の２位で追いかけている。

items.title: サッカー＝町野が得点、宇野が初アシスト　ボルシアＭＧは初白星
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは２３日、１試合を行い、町野修斗が今季２ゴール目を挙げたボルシアＭＧは敵地でシュツットガルトに３─２で勝利した。

町野と橋岡大樹、宇野禅斗の日本人３選手が先発したボルシアＭＧは、前半５分に先制を許す。それでも、同３８分には宇野がボレーシュートを放つと、ゴール前のジョー・スカリーが右足ヒールでコースを変えてネットを揺らし、同点に追いついた。宇野は今夏のチーム加入後初アシスト。

さらにボルシアＭＧは後半６分、味方の折り返しから正面の町野が左足でシュートを沈めて逆転。チームは同２１分にも追加点を奪ってリードを広げると、その後に１点を返されるも逃げ切った。

リーグ開幕から６連敗だったボルシアＭＧは、７戦目で初白星。橋岡と宇野がフル出場し、町野は後半３９分までプレーした。板倉滉はメンバー外だった。

items.title: 陸上＝競歩の池田、ドーピング違反処分取り消し　競技復帰可能に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２３日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２３日　ロイター］ - スポーツ仲裁裁判所（ＣＡＳ）は２３日、陸上男子２０キロ競歩で２０２１年東京五輪銀メダリストの池田向希（２８）に科されていた４年間の資格停止処分を取り消すと発表した。ドーピング違反が立証されなかったとして池田の不服申し立てを認め、ただちに競技復帰が可能となった。

池田は選手の血液データを蓄積する「生体パスポート」の数値に異常が見られたことからドーピングを疑われ、２４年１１月に暫定的な資格停止処分を受けた。２５年２月には世界陸連から４年間の資格停止処分を科された。

一貫してドーピングを否定してきた池田は同年３月にＣＡＳへ不服を申し立て、今年５月にスイスのローザンヌで聴聞会が開かれた。

ＣＡＳは生体パスポートの複数の数値に異常があったことを認めた一方、ドーピング以外の合理的な説明が可能と判断。池田側が提出した医学的証拠や専門家の意見により、世界陸連の裁定機関による審理時よりも幅広い事実関係が明らかになったとし、違反は立証されていないと結論付けた。

池田は２２年世界選手権でも銀メダルを獲得し、２４年パリ五輪では７位だった。今回の裁定により、２８年ロサンゼルス五輪への出場にも道が開けた。

items.body:

前日首位のチャンドラー・ブランシェ（米国）は最終１８番でバーディーを奪うなど、４アンダーの６７をマークし、平田と並ぶ首位を維持した。

items.title: Boeing supplier dispute has halted 777 freighter production for two months, sources say
items.author: Dan Catchpole
items.creator: Dan Catchpole
items.summary: Boeing's dispute with a small Florida-based supplier has halted production of its 777 freighter for nearly two months and disrupted output of the 767, including freighters and KC-46 aerial refueling tankers, according to Boeing workers and court filings.
items.body:
Boeing's (BA.N) dispute with a small Florida-based supplier has halted production of its 777 freighter for nearly two months and disrupted output of the 767, including freighters and KC-46 aerial refueling tankers, according to Boeing workers and court filings.
Boeing filed a complaint in August alleging supplier Vaero had stopped delivering a critical wing component known as the trailing-edge rib kit, stalling work at the Everett, Washington, wing-production facility that supports the 777 freighter and 767 programs, according to a copy of the complaint reviewed by Reuters. The disruption was costing Boeing as much as $6.5 million a day, the complaint said.
Boeing said in the complaint that the trailing-edge rib kit was an "indispensable" part and Vaero was the sole supplier.
Although the companies reached a settlement in late September, production of the 777 freighter has yet to resume, according to three Boeing workers familiar with the matter. They declined to be named because they were not authorized to speak publicly.
The dispute also disrupted production of the 767, a widebody cargo and military aircraft, the people said. Since the settlement, Boeing has received some parts for the 767 line, according to one of the workers.
The prolonged disruption highlights the fragility of aerospace supply chains, showing how a dispute involving a single supplier can halt production of aircraft that remain in strong demand.
The lawsuit was first reported by Law.com in August, but the nearly two-month production disruption has not previously been reported.
Boeing declined to comment. Vaero did not respond to requests for comment.
BRINGING PRODUCTION IN-HOUSE Boeing is trying to bring production of the trailing-edge rib kit in-house, according to two of the people. The component is used in wing assembly for the 767 and current-generation 777 freighter. Boeing's 777X, which uses composite wings, has not been affected.
Without the Vaero parts, Boeing removed two partially assembled 777 freighters from its final assembly line, according to one Boeing worker.
Using data from aviation consultancy IBA, Reuters identified one of the aircraft as destined for FedEx (FDX.N) .
FedEx did not respond to a request for comment.
Boeing has delivered 21 777 freighters so far this year, company data show. It also has a handful of freighters whose wings were assembled before the dispute and could still be delivered before year-end, according to two of the Boeing workers.

items.author: CNA

France boosts police presence, hoping to prevent repeat of riots

Anger over living costs and strained public services has drawn students, workers and unions onto the streets in recent weeks.

Workers remove graffiti from the pedestal of the equestrian statue of Louis XIV at the Place Bellecour in Lyon, ahead of nationwide protests against the cost of living and rising fuel prices in France, Oct 23, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Lisi Niesner)

FAST

PARIS: France will deploy 70,000 police at nationwide protests on Saturday (Oct 24), Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said on Friday, looking to prevent a repeat of the violence and looting that shocked the country last weekend.
Elite security teams and heavily armed mobile squads will be mobilised alongside regular units in a show of force aimed at dispelling fears the government has lost control of the streets.
"We will be uncompromising with rioters, looters and all those who commit acts of violence," Nunez told reporters, adding that "ultra-left" groups had been urging activists online to target public buildings and unleash more lawlessness.
"We are not talking about a nice, friendly demonstration," Nunez said. "We are ready for tomorrow. We will be extremely vigilant, extremely firm, and we will let absolutely nothing pass."
